newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Dongsuh Sec, Coryo Sec down on Sammi.
newsitem.headline: Dongsuh Sec, Coryo Sec down on Sammi.

text.p: Shares of Dongsuh Securities and Coryo Securities went limit down in afternoon trading on Wednesday, hit by the Sammi Group's difficulties, brokers said.
The two firms had guaranteed payment of corporate bonds by Sammi's affiliates.
Dongsuh lost 400 won to 4,600 won and Coryo shed 460 won to a 1997 low of 5,350.
A Sammi Group official said payment guarantees by Coryo Securities amounted to 90 billion won and Dongsuh 63.6 billion.
Sammi Steel and other affiliates, including its trading arm Sammi Corp, filed with for protection from creditors with a Seoul court on Tuesday.
The news hit share prices of financial companies hard.
